fields.summary_ko.0: Advantest Corp. (TYO:6857) stock price rose 7.3% on strong demand for AI chip test equipment, with operating profit guidance raised 14%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Revised consolidated operating profit guidance for March 2027 to JPY 96.7 billion ($630 million), with revenue increasing 60.5% and net income surging 116.8%.
fields.summary_ko.2: The high-performance tester market for AI semiconductors is expected to reach record levels, with demand for AI chip inference equipment expanding amid increased data center investments.
